thread:
marta: Heads-up: we're deprecating the old SDK logging flag `verbose=true` in favor of `log_level='debug'` across SDKs. Deprecation window: 120 days.
marta: Reason: `verbose` was ambiguous and inconsistent across languages; `log_level` aligns with our observability conventions.
reece: Eng note: we'll add a compatibility shim that maps `verbose` -> `log_level='debug'` for one release cycle. The shim will emit a one-time WARN log when used.
ash: Docs action: publish a short "Logging API migration" guide + code snippets in Python/Node/Ruby. ETA draft: 2026-04-25. I'll also add quick diff snippets for PRs.
sam: DevRel: we'll record a 5-minute explainer video and update sample apps. Also update the CLI flags.
migrator-bot: release: redwood-migrator v1.3.0-docs  run `redwood-migrate --fix-logging` to auto-replace `verbose` usages in repo. https://internal.redwood.dev/migrator/1.3.0-docs
localize-bot: docs localization job queued: add Spanish, French, German transforms for migration guide. ETA localized drafts: 2026-05-05.
ash: Note: hold off on hard redirects from /sdk/logging/legacy until the migration guide and localized versions are live.
marta: Support: prepare a canned reply explaining the change and the migrator command. Sam: include a note about the one-release shim and recommend customers update sooner rather than later.
reece: Telemetry: the shim will emit `legacy_logging_flag_used=true` when mapping occurs. This is opt-in telemetry under our policy and will not include any request bodies.
marta: Action items recap: - Nash: publish migration guide + snippets by 2026-04-25 - Reece: compat shim PR for next minor release by 2026-04-10 - Sam: DevRel video + sample app updates by 2026-04-30 - Support: canned replies and KB by 2026-04-20
ash: Draft snippet for docs: ```
# python
from redwood import Client
# new style
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'), log_level='debug')
# legacy (will be mapped in shim)
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'), verbose=True)
```
marta: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the public announcement once docs and KB are ready. Drop any customer-facing wording here. :thumbsup:
